STCW.label: STCW
aliases: Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping

provisions.title: Thermally insulated immersion suits
provisions.text: Thermally insulated suits for everyone aboard cargo ships carrying bulk cargo, and cargo ships operating north of 30° N or south of 30° S.

provisions.title: Immersion suits and insulation
provisions.text: SOLAS refers to the LSA Code. The Code sets out separate performance standards for suits with and without inherent insulation.

provisions.title: Navigation bridge visibility
provisions.text: The full visibility requirements cover qualifying ships built from 1 July 1998, including ships shorter than 55 m. The regulation specifies arrangements and exceptions.

provisions.title: Navigation bridge visibility
provisions.citation: SOLAS V/22.1 as amended by MSC.142(77)
provisions.text: The full standard applies to ships of at least 55 m length overall built on or after 1 July 1998.

provisions.title: Noise risk assessment and survey report
provisions.text: Assess noise before the vessel enters service and when significant changes affect exposure. Keep the survey report available aboard.

provisions.title: Construction standard for protection against noise
provisions.text: The mandatory construction standard normally starts at 1,600 GT and has construction-date conditions.

provisions.title: Stability and tonnage calculations
provisions.text: Use approved calculation software and the same database for stability and tonnage calculations.

provisions.title: Stability information for the master
provisions.text: Provide the master with stability information satisfactory to the administration and furnish a copy to the administration.

provisions.title: Intact stability when towing
provisions.text: A vessel that tows must meet additional intact stability criteria, including the test at 65% of its maximum towing force.

provisions.title: Stability guidance for towing
provisions.text: The IMO towing stability criteria are in Part B of the 2008 IS Code, which contains recommendations.

provisions.title: Pilot-transfer exceptions
provisions.text: The UK regulation states exceptions to SOLAS V/23 for ships under 150 GT, ships under 500 GT on non-international voyages, and fishing vessels.

provisions.title: Pilot transfer arrangements
provisions.text: Regulation V/23 governs transfers of pilots and other personnel.

relations.difference: Norway requires built-in thermal insulation for these routes or cargoes.
Norway extends the visibility standard to qualifying shorter ships.
Norwegian workplace noise assessment and documentation also cover the 500–1,599 GT range.
Norway specifies the approval of the software and use of a common database.
Norway makes specific additional towing stability criteria mandatory for vessels that tow.
The UK regulation states tonnage, voyage and fishing-vessel exceptions to the identified SOLAS rule.

events.title: FAL Recommended Practice 6.24
events.description: Recommendations for governments on vaccination and access to medical care for seafarers during international public health emergencies.

events.title: Ship reporting systems
events.description: Revised mandatory reporting in the Adriatic Sea, the Sound and Great Belt.
